-- F3XE V3 MADE BY EPICRC7
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local Close = Instance.new("TextButton")
local Minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")
local Tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
local MainTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ExtrasTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
local ExecutorTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
local FeedbackTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
local CreditsTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
local Extras = Instance.new("Frame")
local Executor = Instance.new("Frame")
local Feedback = Instance.new("Frame")
local Credits = Instance.new("Frame")

-- Insert GUI to CoreGui
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.Name = "F3XE"

-- GUI properties
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.2, 0)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 350)
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Background Image
local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel", MainFrame)
bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
bg.Image = "rbxassetid://525203397"
bg.BackgroundTransparency = 1

Title.Parent = MainFrame
Title.Text = "F3XE V3"
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextScaled = true

Close.Parent = MainFrame
Close.Text = "X"
Close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
Close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 0)
Close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)

Minimize.Parent = MainFrame
Minimize.Text = "-"
Minimize.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
Minimize.Position = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 0)
Minimize.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
local minimized = false
Minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	for _, child in pairs(MainFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
			if child ~= Title and child ~= Close and child ~= Minimize then
				child.Visible = not minimized
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Tabs System
Tabs.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 30)
Tabs.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
Tabs.Parent = MainFrame

local function CreateTabButton(name, pos)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Text = name
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos, 0, 0)
	btn.Parent = Tabs
	return btn
end

MainTab = CreateTabButton("Main", 0)
ExtrasTab = CreateTabButton("Extras", 100)
ExecutorTab = CreateTabButton("Executor", 200)
FeedbackTab = CreateTabButton("Feedback", 300)
CreditsTab = CreateTabButton("Credits", 400)

-- Frame System
local function CreateFrame()
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -80)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 80)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Visible = false
	frame.Parent = MainFrame
	return frame
end

Main = CreateFrame()
Extras = CreateFrame()
Executor = CreateFrame()
Feedback = CreateFrame()
Credits = CreateFrame()

local function SwitchTab(tab)
	Main.Visible = (tab == Main)
	Extras.Visible = (tab == Extras)
	Executor.Visible = (tab == Executor)
	Feedback.Visible = (tab == Feedback)
	Credits.Visible = (tab == Credits)
end

MainTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(Main) end)
ExtrasTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(Extras) end)
ExecutorTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(Executor) end)
FeedbackTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(Feedback) end)
CreditsTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SwitchTab(Credits) end)

-- Buttons for Main
local function CreateMainButton(text, parent, func)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, (#parent:GetChildren()-1)*60)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	btn.Parent = parent
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

CreateMainButton("B2S🟦", Main, function()
	loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-blue2spooky-gui-reborn-41879"))()
end)
CreateMainButton("1eggs🥚", Main, function()

-- Extras Buttons
CreateMainButton("LNickyz", Extras, function()

-- Executor
local Box = Instance.new("TextBox", Executor)
Box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 200)
Box.PlaceholderText = "Insert Script Here"
Box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 20)
local ExecuteBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Executor)
ExecuteBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
ExecuteBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 240)
ExecuteBtn.Text = "Execute"
ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

-- Feedback
local FeedBox = Instance.new("TextBox", Feedback)
FeedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 200)
FeedBox.PlaceholderText = "Send Feedback..."

FeedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	FeedBox.Text = "Thanks for your feedback!"
	wait(2)

-- Credits
local CreditLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", Credits)
CreditLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
